subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

EXTRACT
solution:
The correct answer is: Withdraw

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Extract means to take something out, especially with difficulty.

 
 
• Example - *I think this tooth will have to be **extracted**.*
 
 
 
• *​*Marked option Withdraw means to remove something or take something away.
 
 
• Example - *He **withdrew **his savings from the bank.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Extract' and 'Withdraw' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Insert means to put something inside or into something else.
 
• Enclose means to surround it or cover it up.
 
• Install means to set up for use or service.
